# Retail Executive Dashboard Plan

A compact executive dashboard should focus on revenue trend, channel mix, and marketing efficiency. This dataset is small but strong enough to show monthly movement and the relationship between spend and results.

## Best 3 Charts for This Retail Dataset

| Chart | What it should show | Axes / labels | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|
| Line chart | Monthly **online_sales** vs **store_sales** over time | X: Month; Y: Sales ($); Series: Online Sales, Store Sales | Best for spotting trend, seasonality, and which channel is leading |
| Combo chart | **ad_spend** as bars with **total sales** as a line | X: Month; Left Y: Ad Spend ($); Right Y: Total Sales ($) | Shows whether marketing spend is moving sales in the same direction |
| Line chart | **refund_rate** by month | X: Month; Y: Refund Rate (%) | Highlights quality or fulfillment issues that could offset growth |

## Chart Recommendations and Dashboard Layout

### 1) Revenue Trend Chart
- **Type:** Dual-line chart
- **Title:** Monthly Sales by Channel
- **X-axis:** Month
- **Y-axis:** Sales in dollars
- **Series:** Online Sales, Store Sales
- **Show:** Both lines on the same scale, with markers on each month
- **Best use:** Executive view of channel performance and growth pace

### 2) Marketing Efficiency Chart
- **Type:** Combo chart
- **Title:** Ad Spend vs Total Sales
- **X-axis:** Month
- **Left Y-axis:** Ad Spend in dollars
- **Right Y-axis:** Total Sales in dollars
- **Series:** Bars for ad_spend, line for total sales
- **Show:** Whether higher spend is associated with higher sales
- **Best use:** Budget and ROI discussion

### 3) Quality / Returns Chart
- **Type:** Simple line chart
- **Title:** Refund Rate Trend
- **X-axis:** Month
- **Y-axis:** Refund Rate as %
- **Show:** Small month-to-month changes clearly, with a target line if available
- **Best use:** Operational health and customer satisfaction monitoring

## Executive Dashboard Layout

### Top Row: KPI Cards
- **Total Sales:** $615,500
- **Online Sales:** $300,000
- **Store Sales:** $315,500
- **Avg Refund Rate:** 4.17%
- **Total Ad Spend:** $52,100

### Middle Row: Core Performance
- Left: **Monthly Sales by Channel** line chart
- Right: **Ad Spend vs Total Sales** combo chart

### Bottom Row: Risk and Quality
- Full width: **Refund Rate Trend** line chart
- Optional note area for month-over-month highlights

## 3 Key Insights

- **Store sales slightly outperform online sales overall**: total store sales are $315.5K vs $300K online, but online catches up in several months and grows steadily.
- **June is the strongest month across the board**: online sales, store sales, and ad spend all peak in June, suggesting the latest month is the best performance point in the series.
- **Refund rate improves as sales rise in the later months**: refund rate drops from 6% in April to 3% in May and June, which is a positive sign for customer experience and execution.

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Build Dashboard](https://www.figma.com/)
- Action: [Button: Create Charts](https://www.google.com/sheets/about/)
- Action: [Button: Analyze Trends](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/excel)

## Sources

- CSV provided in the prompt
- Chart design guidance: https://www.data-to-viz.com/
- Executive dashboard principles: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/dashboard-design-principles
